The club hosts league nights on Tuesday/Wednesday/Thursday and a Free Casual Beginners Tournament EVERY FRIDAY at 7pm!

FRIDAY NIGHT PETANQUE!

We host a FREE open melee tournament. No RSVP required! Just show up by 7pm and we’ll mix up some teams for a casual tournament. Each team is guaranteed three games and we always finish by 10pm! Fridays are perfect for beginners.
